intro: Statutory outputs built from the payroll runs you have already approved. Preview one to see what it contains and what is missing, then download the file for the portal.

ecr.title: PF ECR
ecr.blurb: Monthly EPFO electronic challan-cum-return. Uploaded to the EPFO employer portal.
ecr.fileHint: ECR v2 text — validate against the EPFO portal before your first live upload.

esi.title: ESI Return
esi.blurb: Monthly ESIC contribution return for insured persons.

form24q.title: Form 24Q
form24q.blurb: Quarterly salary-TDS return, reconciled against the challans you have recorded.
form24q.fileHint: CSV for a return preparer — not the FVU e-TDS file itself.

form16.title: Form 16 (Part B)
form16.blurb: An employee's annual salary and TDS statement. Part A comes from TRACES.

wps.title: WPS Salary File
wps.blurb: Wage Protection System file for the bank / labour ministry.
wps.fileHint: v1 layout — validate with your WPS agent bank before your first live submission.
